title: ReCoPII: A Relation-Grounded Framework for Building Contextual PII Masking Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2610.35925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training contextual masking systems for personally identifiable information (PII) requires examples distinguishing maskable from preservable mentions of one entity type, but privacy restrictions limit access to real data. Author-based augmentation (SPY) labels mentions unrelated to the author as non-PII, presuming a single data subject and overlooking others. We propose ReCoPII (Relation-grounded Contextual PII masking), a framework that builds such data without this premise: it plans ontology-constrained entity relations, writes insertion sentences with placeholders, reconstructs annotations with code, checks the result with a separate LLM, and derives MASK/KEEP labels from entity relations. On Korean documents from six domains, it yields ReCoPII-Ko, a corpus with relation, privacy, and MASK/KEEP annotations, which we validate. Across 300 pairs, four annotators agree with 88.42% of its sampled KEEP labels, against 26.27% for SPY-style

translated_title: ReCoPII：一种基于关系构建情境化PII脱敏数据集的框架
translated_abstract: 训练针对个人身份信息（PII）的情境化脱敏系统，需要能够区分同一实体类型中“可脱敏”与“应保留”提及的样本，但隐私限制使得真实数据难以获取。基于作者的增强方法（SPY）将与作者无关的提及标注为非PII，这一做法假定了单一数据主体，从而忽略了其他主体。我们提出了ReCoPII（基于关系的情境化PII脱敏），一个无需上述前提即可构建此类数据的框架：它首先规划受本体约束的实体关系，然后撰写带有占位符的插入句，再通过代码重建标注，用独立的LLM检查结果，并根据实体关系推导出MASK/KEEP标签。在来自六个领域的韩文文档上，该框架生成了ReCoPII-Ko语料库，其中包含关系、隐私和MASK/KEEP三类标注，我们对其进行了验证。在300对样本中，四名标注者对其抽样KEEP标签的认可率达88.42%，而SPY风格方法仅为26.27%。
tldr: ReCoPII框架通过规划本体约束的实体关系并据此推导MASK/KEEP标签，无需单一数据主体假设即可自动构建情境化PII脱敏数据集，所生成的韩文语料ReCoPII-Ko的KEEP标签获得88.42%的标注者认可率，远超SPY方法的26.27%。
en_tdlr: ReCoPII is a relation-grounded framework that constructs contextual PII masking datasets without assuming a single data subject by planning ontology-constrained entity relations and deriving MASK/KEEP labels, producing the Korean corpus ReCoPII-Ko whose KEEP labels achieve 88.42% annotator agreement versus 26.27% for SPY-style augmentation.
